reason.NO_DING: No ding. Put the ding in round brackets, e.g. (D) A C D E.
reason.NO_DING.which: Which note is the ding? Put it in round brackets, e.g. (D) A C D E, or put a | straight after it: D | A C D E.
reason.NO_DING.two: Two dings. Only the ding takes round brackets; a bottom note takes square ones, e.g. [C] (D) A C.
reason.NO_DING.below: {X} comes before the ding, so it must be a bottom note. Write it in square brackets, e.g. [C] (D) A C.
reason.NO_FIFTH: No perfect fifth above the ding {X}. Add a {fifth}, or check the ding.
reason.BAD_NOTE: {X} is not a note. Use names like C, F#, Bb, with an optional octave, e.g. (D) A Bb C.
reason.BAD_NOTE.slash: A lone / is the old way to mark inner notes. Use | now, e.g. (D) A C D | E F.
reason.BAD_NOTE.bracket: {X} is not a bottom note. Give each bottom note its own square brackets, no spaces inside, e.g. [C] [D] (E) B.
reason.BAD_NOTE.bar: Too many | marks. One | starts the inner notes, e.g. (D) A C D | E F. A bottom note takes square brackets instead: [C].
reason.BAD_NOTE.barEmpty: A | needs top notes before it and inner notes after it, e.g. (D) A C D | E F.
reason.BAD_NOTE.barFirst: The | comes after the ding and the top notes, e.g. (D) A C D | E F.
reason.NOTE_OUT_OF_RANGE: {A} is off the keyboard: a note must be between C-1 and G9.
reason.NOTE_OUT_OF_ORDER: {A} is not above {B}, and the line runs low to high. Give {A} a higher octave or move it earlier, e.g. (D3) A3 C4 D4.
reason.NOTE_OUT_OF_ORDER.ding: {A} is at or below the ding {B}. Top notes are above the ding; a lower note is a bottom note and goes before it in square brackets, e.g. [C3] (D3) A3.
reason.NOTE_REPEATED: {B} and {A} are the same note, and a note may appear only once per shell. A bottom copy takes square brackets and its octave, e.g. (D3) A3 [C4] C4.
reason.NEEDS_NEWER_APP: This link needs a newer version of the app. Reload.
reason.NO_THIRDS: No 3rds on this pan: only power chords and sus chords.
reason.PROFILE_UNKNOWN: This Neotone layout is not one this app knows.
reason.PROFILE_MAP_INVALID: The Neotone layout is malformed: it must list 9 main and 9 mutant tonefields, each empty or one of your notes, top notes in the main ones and bottom notes in the mutant ones.
reason.PROFILE_NOTE_MISSING: The Neotone layout leaves out one of your notes. Every note needs a tonefield.
reason.PROFILE_NOTE_TWICE: The Neotone layout places the same note in two tonefields.
reason.PROFILE_FULL: Neotone holds at most 9 top notes and 9 bottom notes and no inner notes. Remove some notes.
reason.PROFILE_CONFLICT: Neotone sets its own placement, so mirror, seats and angles cannot be combined with it.
reason.SMALL_LABELS: Crowded pan: the smallest labels print at {N} pt, under the 3.6 pt this app treats as readable. Nothing is left out.
sheet.toggle_refused: Not changed: it would put a note you moved too close to another. Reset layout first.
sheet.cannot_trade: Not moved. {a} and {b} cannot trade places on the {step}° steps.

saved.sessionImportAckPending: This shared scale is temporary, and its view could not be refreshed. Keep this tab open and keep the incoming link. Reloading or closing the tab loses temporary changes.
